The artist

rocKsun

Marathi hip-hop artist from Maharashtra. A sharp, intense flow, with lyrics on discipline, resilience and self-belief, rooted in the state's history of courage.

Featured by LiFTED Asia as one of Marathi hip-hop's most commanding new voices.

The cause

A show with
a purpose.

All of rocKsun's earnings from this concert will go towards charity, for drought-hit farmers of Maharashtra. Rashtra Seva Dal will handle the money and reach it directly to the farmers.

Concert night

Books, ideas, music

A festival of literature and thinkers. Book stalls, music gigs and big voices, with visitors of all ages. Inaugurated by Sharad Pawar.

Where

Ganesh Kala Krida, Swargate, Pune. Backed by Rashtra Seva Dal. RocKsun Sabha closes the festival on 29 November.

The platform

Backed by
a legacy.

Kalapaath

Kalapaath is backed by Rashtra Seva Dal, and so is the Phule Festival. It carries a big legacy: Smita Patil once served as its chief, and Nilu Phule was associated with it, along with many noted names from the arts and public life.
